elements.name: small town along top of high green ridge
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs
small terraced fields on steep slopes
layered mountains fading into blue haze

wrong_setting: The houses have terracotta-tiled pitched roofs rather than corrugated tin, and the tall dark columnar trees read as Italian cypresses or poplars rather than eucalyptus. Together they make the scene look like Tuscany or the Mediterranean, not the Ethiopian highlands.
notes: Repaint the roofs as rusty corrugated tin sheets and replace the cypress-like trees with loose, pale-trunked eucalyptus so it reads as Ethiopia; also warm up the gold morning light.
